Definition: from G2095 and a presumed derivative of G3330; good at imparting, i.e. liberal:--ready to distribute.
BiblicalUsage: eumetádotos means ready to distribute. In 1 Timothy 6:18, the text says "That they do good."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, eumetádotos means ready to distribute, nothing more and nothing less.
